cards.name: Define Pattern Menu Item
cards.summary: Defaults.kys id with no menu entry, display name or shortcut in Illustrator 30.2.1. Its name and its place in the shortcut file (in the Edit-menu block, right after the Edit Colors dialogs and before Edit Custom Dictionary) mark it as the Edit > Define Pattern... command of Illustrator CS5 and earlier, which turned the selected artwork into a new pattern swatch in one step, the art's bounding box becoming the tile. Since CS6 that job is Object > Pattern > Make (id 'Adobe Make Pattern'), which opens Pattern Editing Mode. Whether this id still runs on 30.2.1 is unknown.
use_for: recognising the id in an old .kys shortcut set, action or script and mapping it to Object > Pattern > Make
seamless pattern swatches for packaging, textile prints and background tiles, made through Object > Pattern > Make or by dragging the art into the Swatches panel
avoid: calling it from a script or action: the id was never run on 30.2.1, so whether it still does anything is unknown (leftover ids from the same list, such as DropShadow2 and Live Round3, raise Error 1200 'BKey')
tiles that need spacing, brick or hex offsets or overlap control: Object > Pattern > Make gives the Pattern Options panel
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Define Pattern Menu Item") is the harvest's invoke string; it was never run on 30.2.1, so whether it still does anything is unknown (other leftover ids from the same Defaults.kys list, such as Roughen3 and Live PSAdapter_plugin_USMk, raise Error 1200 'BKey'). Working route: select the art and app.executeMenuCommand("Adobe Make Pattern"), which adds the swatch and enters Pattern Editing Mode (leave it with Done or Escape).

corner-pin reshaping of a logo or label onto a box face, done through the live effect Effect > Distort & Transform > Free Distort
avoid: calling it from a script or action: the id was never run on 30.2.1, so whether it still does anything is unknown (its neighbours in the same list, Roughen3, ZigZag2 and DropShadow2, raise Error 1200 'BKey')
perspective that has to stay editable: use the live Free Distort effect or the Perspective Grid
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Distort2") is the harvest's invoke string; it was never run on 30.2.1, so whether it still does anything is unknown (other leftover ids from the same Defaults.kys list, such as Roughen3 and Live PSAdapter_plugin_USMk, raise Error 1200 'BKey'). Working route for a corner-pin distortion: select the art and app.executeMenuCommand("Live Free Distort") (opens the Free Distort dialog; live-effect name 'Adobe Free Distort').

cards.name: DropShadow2

It sits with the old Filter-menu ids (Round3, AddArrowHeads2, Roughen3), so it is probably the Filter > Stylize > Drop Shadow of Illustrator CS3 and earlier, which drew the shadow as real, separate artwork behind the selection. Shadows now come from the live effect Effect > Stylize > Drop Shadow (id 'Live Adobe Drop Shadow'), which stays editable in the Appearance panel.

cards.name: Dynamic Text

The Select > Object submenu of 30.2.1 has no Flash entries and there is no Flash Text panel, so it probably finds nothing to select; it was never run in the harvest.
use_for: recognising the id in an old .kys shortcut set, action or script
understanding legacy CS5 / CS6 files that were set up for Flash
avoid: calling it from a script or action: the id was never run on 30.2.1, so whether it still does anything is unknown

cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Dynamic Text") is the harvest's invoke string; it was never run on 30.2.1, so whether it does anything is unknown. cards.name: Expand Planet X
cards.summary: Probably the hidden command id of Object > Live Paint > Expand: 'Planet X' is Illustrator's internal name for Live Paint (Make is 'Make Planet X', Merge is 'Marge Planet X'), the id sits with them in the shortcut file, and the harvest's Keyboard Shortcuts alignment pointed at Object/Live Paint/Expand, though it could not confirm the pairing. Expand turns the selected Live Paint group into ordinary artwork: every painted face becomes a filled path and every painted edge a stroked path, in groups, so the colours stay but the gap-aware bucket painting ends.
use_for: finishing a coloured line-art illustration or logo made with the Live Paint Bucket so it can go to print, a cutter or another app as plain paths
a script step that has to reach Live Paint Expand, which has no object-model call
avoid: you still want to recolour regions with the Live Paint Bucket: expand only at the end, or keep a copy
you want the line art back without the paint: use Object > Live Paint > Release
no Live Paint group selected: there is nothing to expand (for other live art use Object > Expand or Object > Expand Appearance)
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Expand Planet X") with a Live Paint group selected (id from Illustrator Defaults.kys; pairing with Object > Live Paint > Expand inferred, not confirmed by execution). No object-model call handles Live Paint.

review.changes: status needs_input -> hidden (the batch lists it only as an unpaired Defaults.kys id that was never run; the menu pairing is inferred)

cards.name: FileClipboardPref
cards.summary: Hidden Defaults.kys id that most likely opens Illustrator's Preferences dialog at its file and clipboard settings. The id dates from when these were one pane, File Handling & Clipboard, and sits in the shortcut file's preference block between 'BlackPref' (Appearance of Black...) and 'pluginPref' (by its name the Plug-ins pane, itself unpaired). In 30.2.1 the settings are split into Edit > Preferences > File Handling... and Clipboard Handling..., neither of which has a paired id of its own; which of the two panes this id opens was not confirmed (it was never run in the harvest).
cards.how: File Handling: Automatically Save Recovery Data every N minutes and its folder, number of recent files, how modified linked files update, and cloud-document save options. Clipboard Handling: the formats put on the clipboard on copy (PDF, and AICB with Preserve Paths or Preserve Appearance and Overprints) and whether pasted text keeps its formatting. OK applies to all documents.
use_for: turning on frequent recovery saves before a long session on a heavy file
fixing artwork that pastes badly into Photoshop, InDesign or Office by changing the clipboard formats
avoid: unattended scripts: it opens the modal Preferences dialog, which waits for OK or Cancel
relying on which pane opens: not confirmed on 30.2.1; check the selected pane in the dialog
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("FileClipboardPref") opens the dialog (id from Defaults.kys; pane not confirmed by execution). Without the dialog (unverified): app.preferences.setIntegerPreference / setBooleanPreference with the matching internal key, which the harvest does not record.

cards.name: Planet X Options
